OMS.scope: customer_booking.customer_organization_id = authorized customer organization; cargo_detail.booking_id must join the selected booking.
OMS.modelInput: Only server-derived bounded evidence codes and opaque evidence IDs. These database projections are not raw model input.
OMS.output: HUMAN_REVIEW with allowlisted reason and evidence IDs; never a command or authorization.

IMS.scope: vehicle.organization_id and vehicle_availability.organization_id = authorized vendor organization; availability.vehicle_id joins that vehicle. Reservation vehicle and driver must independently belong to the same vendor. order_id is a cross-tenant customer reference: never expose booking data without a separate customer grant.
IMS.modelInput: Only server-derived bounded evidence codes and opaque evidence IDs. These database projections are not raw model input.
IMS.output: HUMAN_REVIEW with allowlisted reason and evidence IDs; never a command or authorization.

TMS.scope: trip.vendor_organization_id = authorized vendor organization; stops/incidents join selected trip. A driver additionally matches trip.driver_id to an active driver_profile for the authenticated user and organization. Booking references do not grant customer data access.
TMS.modelInput: Only server-derived bounded evidence codes and opaque evidence IDs. These database projections are not raw model input.
TMS.output: HUMAN_REVIEW with allowlisted reason and evidence IDs; never a command or authorization.

VERIFICATION.scope: POD joins authorized trip; stop_id must join a stop of that trip and driver_id must match its driver. compliance_documents owner_type selects organization, vehicle or driver_profile; resolve owner_id through that type and verify organization independently. No generic owner_id authorization.
VERIFICATION.modelInput: Only server-derived bounded evidence codes and opaque evidence IDs. These database projections are not raw model input.
VERIFICATION.output: HUMAN_REVIEW with allowlisted reason and evidence IDs; never a command or authorization.

FINANCE_COMPLIANCE.scope: Explicit finance grant plus target organization required. Customer payment/refund scope and vendor settlement scope are separate projections: never merge across organizations because a trip references a booking. Refund payment_transaction_id and booking_id must agree.
FINANCE_COMPLIANCE.modelInput: Only server-derived bounded evidence codes and opaque evidence IDs. These database projections are not raw model input.
FINANCE_COMPLIANCE.output: HUMAN_REVIEW with allowlisted reason and evidence IDs; never a command or authorization.

sharedRequirements: Authenticate server-side; reject suspended users, inactive organization or revoked membership before reading records.
Derive user, tenant and agent grants from trusted backend state, never browser/model role fields.
Recheck membership and record freshness before returning or storing a recommendation.
Only customer_booking has the mapped version field; other entities need an approved transactional snapshot/revision strategy. Do not invent version=1.
No prompts, secrets, private storage keys, OTPs, contacts, claim tokens or raw free text reach models.
All joins must be scoped before projection; no external models, schedules, triggers or business writes.
Amounts require explicit units and rounding policy before numerical comparison; currency matching is mandatory.
